scripts.clean:full: npm run clean && rm -rf packages/openbridge-webcomponents/.full-bundle-publish && find packages/openbridge-webcomponents-ng packages/openbridge-webcomponents-react packages/openbridge-webcomponents-svelte packages/openbridge-webcomponents-vue -mindepth 1 ! -name 'README.md' ! -name 'AGENTS.md' -exec rm -rf {} + || true
scripts.check: npm run check -w packages/openbridge-webcomponents -w packages/react-demo -w packages/vue-demo -w packages/connector-diagram
scripts.build:demo: npm run build:full -w packages/openbridge-webcomponents && npm install && npm run build -w packages/openbridge-webcomponents-vue && npm run build -w packages/vue-demo
